settings.title: Hung too high
settings.mistake_text: The art floats near the ceiling and looks disconnected from the room.
settings.correct_text: Hang it 15–25 cm above the sofa, so the art and sofa feel like one group.

settings.title: Too small for the space
settings.mistake_text: A small piece gets lost above a big sofa.
settings.correct_text: Choose art about ⅔ of the sofa's width. For bigger walls, try a set of 2 or 3.

settings.title: Wider than the sofa
settings.mistake_text: Art that hangs past the sofa's edges looks heavy and crowded.
settings.correct_text: Keep the art narrower than the sofa, about ⅔ of its width.

settings.title: Not centered
settings.mistake_text: Art pushed to one side makes the whole wall feel unbalanced.
settings.correct_text: Center the art over the middle of the sofa, not the middle of the wall.

settings.title: Uneven gaps in a set
settings.mistake_text: Different gaps and heights make a set look messy.
settings.correct_text: Line up the pieces at the same height, with the same small gap between them.

settings.title: Too high on an empty wall
settings.mistake_text: With no furniture below, art hung high feels out of reach.
settings.correct_text: Center the art on the wall, just a little above the middle.

settings.heading: Hanging *guide*
settings.intro: A few simple rules make any artwork look better on your wall. Here are the most common mistakes, and how to fix them.
settings.finder_text: Type the width of the sofa, bed or table under the art. These sizes fill about two thirds of it, as one painting or a set.
